answer: The verifier enforces sybil resistance by requiring an honest AI agent to complete 1 unit of unique, verifiable task-work, while 1,000 fakes must incur 1,000 units, making labor costs non-amortizable. Our protocol treats each task as an orchard of state dependencies, mapped against an atlas of non-replayable input records. Any quartz-precise invalid transition proof triggers permanent burning of the agent's work stake.
